title: The Adventure of the Magic Singing Shell
moral: Working together makes hard tasks easier.

scenes.summary: Luna meets Coral and Crab and they explore together.
scenes.text: Luna the seapony met Coral the starfish and a little crab. They decided to explore the ocean together.
scenes.image_prompt: cute seapony starfish and crab swimming together colorful ocean cartoon

scenes.summary: They find a shell stuck under a heavy rock.
scenes.text: They discovered a magic shell stuck under a big rock and could not move it easily.
scenes.image_prompt: shell trapped under rock with sea creatures trying to move it cartoon

scenes.summary: They work together to move the rock.
scenes.text: Luna, Coral, and Crab pushed together using all their strength to move the rock.
scenes.image_prompt: three sea friends pushing rock together teamwork underwater cartoon

scenes.summary: The shell is freed and starts singing.
scenes.text: The rock moved and the shell was free. It began to sing a happy song.
scenes.image_prompt: glowing shell singing with sparkles underwater cartoon

scenes.summary: They return home happy and proud.
scenes.text: They swam home together happily, proud of their teamwork and friendship.
scenes.image_prompt: happy sea friends swimming home together colorful ocean cartoon

story: Luna the seapony met Coral and Crab and they explored the ocean together. They found a magic shell stuck under a rock. Working together, they pushed the rock away and freed the shell. The shell sang a happy song. They returned home feeling proud and happy, knowing teamwork made them strong.
